name: GitHub Power Sync
description: Prompts user to sync AI-DLC user stories to GitHub Projects after User Stories stage completes, and provides manual sync trigger.

then.prompt: The User Stories stage has completed. Check if the GitHub Power is configured (github-power/config.json exists). If configured, ask the user: 'Would you like to sync user stories to GitHub Projects?' with options A) Yes - Sync now, B) No - Continue without syncing. If they choose Yes, ask them to select a mapping strategy and then call the sync_stories MCP tool. If the Power is not configured, inform the user that GitHub Power is not set up and continue the workflow.
